mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to a tightening monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the CPI trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 6 months indicates strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the HOUST trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the UNRATE trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% within a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which boosts equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the FEDFUNDS trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the previous 3 months signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the INDPRO trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 1% month-over-month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the same period, it signals strong consumer demand and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% MoM and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% MoM
regime_hint: strong consumer demand and tight labor market
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the interaction trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous 3 months signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the PAYEMS trend is positive.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 2% over the previous 6 months, it signals a tightening monetary policy in an inflationary environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL increase > 2% over 6 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the interaction trigger condition is met.
